title.zh: 将北甘马粦省 Basud市镇 Tuaca 小学的名称变更为Pedro Rada 小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tuaca Elementary School in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, to Pedro Rada Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tuaca Elementary School in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, to Pedro Rada Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Tuaca tại Thị trấn Basud, Tỉnh Camarines Norte thành Trường tiểu học Pedro Rada
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tuaca ในเทศบาล Basud, จังหวัด Camarines Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pedro Rada
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Tuaca di Kotamadya Basud, Provinsi Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Pedro Rada
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Tuaca di Perbandaran Basud, Wilayah Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Rendah Pedro Rada

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5030_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tuaca Elementary School in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, is hereby changed to Pedro Rada Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
